subject: Disability Fair Planning and GLX Station Accessibility
overview: The commission finalized logistical arrangements for the upcoming October 7th Disability Fair and addressed serious accessibility concerns regarding the new Tufts Green Line Extension station.

items.title: Welcome and Introductions
items.summary: Commission members introduced themselves and discussed their backgrounds in Medford and history with the board.

items.title: Meeting Schedule Adjustments
items.summary: The commission moved the November meeting to November 29th to avoid the Thanksgiving holiday and tabled a decision on the December meeting date.

items.title: Disability Fair Update
items.summary: Staff provided a final list of exhibitors and speakers for the October 7th event, including a mobile COVID-19 vaccine clinic and ASL interpretation services.

items.title: Volunteer Task Assignments
items.summary: Commissioners assigned specific event roles including ushering, staffing the commission information table, and emceeing the program.

items.title: Event Logistics and Equipment
items.summary: The discussion covered the procurement of a projector screen for the screening of 'Intelligent Lives' and the coordination of additional accessible parking spots.

items.title: Tufts GLX Station Accessibility Concerns
items.summary: The commission reviewed complaints regarding the complete absence of accessible parking at the new Tufts Green Line Extension station and planned a site visit with traffic engineers.

items.title: MBTA Accessibility Campaign
items.summary: Members discussed a new MBTA visibility initiative, arguing that physical infrastructure improvements are more vital for the community than visual representation campaigns.

items.title: Announcements and Future Business
items.summary: Staff announced a Hispanic Heritage celebration on October 1st and proposed a future discussion regarding a formal name change for the commission.
